title: All Locations - Expedition 33 Map & Area Guide
description: Complete list of all locations in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Explore every area, dungeon, and secret location on the Continent with our comprehensive guide.

sections.title: The Continent - World Overview
sections.content:
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 takes place on a vast, painterly Continent filled with diverse environments — from coastal villages to volcanic caverns, mystical forests to ancient ruins. Each area contains unique enemies, Pictos, weapons, and secrets.

This guide covers every major location, organized by region and progression order.

sections.title: General Exploration Tips
sections.content:
• Follow lit lamps — they always mark the critical path. Unlit paths lead to optional areas with bonus loot.
  • DANGER zones — Come back later when leveled up, or bring your strongest party.
  • Esquie abilities — Swim, dive, climb, and eventually fly. Many areas require specific traversal unlocks.
  • White Nevrons — Friendly NPCs in many locations. Bring them requested items (usually found nearby) for rewards.
  • Paint Cages — Find and shoot 3 red marks to open loot containers.
  • Camp often — Press D-Down to camp, upgrade gear, and build relationships.
